name: config_io
description: Configuration import / export - round-trip the configuration to XML, dump it to a .cf, import a .cf or .cfe someone sent you, export an object to an .epf/.erf, export a common picture, export selected objects out of the infobase itself. Operations: export_configuration_to_xml, import_configuration_from_xml, import_configuration_from_binary, export_object, export_common_picture, export_configuration_to_cf, export_infobase_objects, export_database_configuration, export_database_extension, unpack_external_binary, help. Pass operation=<name> (snake_case canonical; camelCase like exportObject is also accepted); remaining parameters follow the per-operation contracts (call operation=help for the catalog). import_configuration_from_xml and import_configuration_from_binary mutate the workspace (each creates a project) and export_object, import_configuration_from_binary and export_infobase_objects may reply with a Pending status and a runKey to resume - the facade only routes, it adds no dryRun. export_configuration_to_cf dumps the infobase's current configuration (run update_database first to capture project changes); export_infobase_objects reads the infobase's own configuration and writes the Designer-XML files to a destination directory; export_database_configuration and export_database_extension are the guarded .cf/.cfe dumps - they refuse an occupied outputPath (overwrite=true overrides) and an infobase that does not hold the project's current configuration (allowOutOfSync=true overrides), so an old file can never pass as the result. The standalone tools remain available for back-compat.

operation.description: export_configuration_to_xml / import_configuration_from_xml / import_configuration_from_binary / export_object / export_common_picture / export_configuration_to_cf / export_infobase_objects / unpack_external_binary / export_database_configuration / export_database_extension / help (snake_case canonical; camelCase like exportObject is also accepted). operation=help lists them; topic=<operation> answers what that one takes.

topic.description: Help topic when operation=help. Without topic - lists all operations with one-line summaries.

find.description: With help: search this help for a case-insensitive substring - all the words must appear inside one chunk, and with topic only that topic is searched.

binaryPath.description: import_configuration_from_binary: absolute path to the .cf or .cfe to import. Required for that operation.

platform.description: import_configuration_from_binary: platform version for the staging infobase (e.g. 8.3.24).

extensionName.description: import_configuration_from_binary, .cfe only: the name to load the extension under. Omit to take it from the file name. export_database_extension: the exact name of the extension to export (required for that operation; list_extension shows the installed names).

baseConfigurationPath.description: import_configuration_from_binary, .cfe only: a .cf to load into the staging infobase first, so the extension has the configuration it borrows from.

keepXmlPath.description: import_configuration_from_binary: keep the intermediate Designer-XML here instead of in a temporary directory that is deleted.

projectName.description: EDT project name. For the import operations it is instead the NEW project to create, which must not already exist.

outputPath.description: Absolute output path (required for export_configuration_to_xml, export_object, export_common_picture, export_configuration_to_cf, export_infobase_objects, export_database_configuration and export_database_extension). export_configuration_to_xml: a directory for the Designer-XML dump (created if missing; existing contents overwritten). export_object: the .epf/.erf file path (extension decides the kind, or it is auto-detected). export_common_picture: a FILE path for the default / single-variant export, or a DIRECTORY path when allVariants=true. export_configuration_to_cf: the .cf file path. export_infobase_objects: a DIRECTORY path that must be absent or empty. export_database_configuration / export_database_extension: the .cf / .cfe file path - an existing file there is refused unless overwrite=true.

objects.description: export_infobase_objects: object addresses to export from the INFOBASE's configuration - a whole top object (Catalog.Банки / Справочник.Банки), a form (Catalog.Банки.Form.ФормаЭлемента, Russian kind spellings too) or a common form (CommonForm.Имя). Required for that operation.

importPath.description: import_configuration_from_xml: absolute path to the directory of Designer-XML files to import (required for that operation).

sourcePath.description: unpack_external_binary: absolute path to the .epf or .erf file to convert (required for that operation).

targetPath.description: unpack_external_binary: directory the XML is written into (required for that operation).

applicationId.description: export_configuration_to_cf, export_database_configuration and export_database_extension: infobase application id (from get_applications).

overwrite.description: export_database_configuration / export_database_extension: allow replacing an existing file at outputPath (default false - an occupied path is refused, so a previous file can never pass as the result).

allowOutOfSync.description: export_database_configuration / export_database_extension: allow dumping while the infobase does not hold the project's current configuration (default false - the dump is refused instead of silently missing changes not yet applied; run update_database first).

skipValidation.description: export_configuration_to_cf: pass 'true' to skip the built-in validate_for_export guard.

baseProjectName.description: Both imports, for an extension: the project of the configuration it extends.

xmlVersion.description: import_configuration_from_xml: platform XML format version (e.g. 8.3.20), or omit to auto-detect.

objectName.description: export_object: object name within the project.

timeoutSeconds.description: export_object: soft timeout in seconds before returning a Pending JSON with a runKey (default 30, range 5-120, clamped). import_configuration_from_binary: the same, for its staging run. export_infobase_objects: the same, for its Designer run.

runKey.description: export_object, import_configuration_from_binary and export_infobase_objects: resumes a previously issued Pending run by its runKey; other params are ignored once runKey is supplied.

name.description: export_common_picture: CommonPicture name, either 'CommonPicture.<Name>' or the bare '<Name>' (required for that operation).

variant.description: export_common_picture: multi-variant only - pick one DPI tier by its manifest entry name (e.g. '200.png'), a bare scale ('200'), or a screenDensity token ('hdpi').

allVariants.description: export_common_picture: multi-variant only - extract every zip entry into outputPath treated as a directory (default false).
